apps.name: EchoKey
apps.short_description: EchoKey is a lightweight soundboard that plays audio directly through your microphone. Trigger sounds instantly in Discord, TeamSpeak, in-game voice chats, and live streams using hotkeys, a mobile remote, an overlay, or Stream Deck.

apps.name: GenderShift
apps.short_description: Embody your avatar. GenderShift is a push-to-talk voice changer that rebuilds your words in a real, natural feminine voice (or masculine, your call), so you pass in VRChat, Discord, anywhere you talk online. Your own voice, shifted.

apps.name: HeadTrack
apps.short_description: Use your phone as a head tracking device for games on your PC.

apps.name: LIV
apps.short_description: All-in-one VR software for creators. Record mixed reality, transform into your favorite avatar, see chat inside your headset, and more.

apps.name: NitLink
apps.short_description: Play 30 fps console games at 60 fps on your PC monitor with experimental frame generation. NitLink is a low-latency capture card viewer with real HDR10 passthrough, picture-in-picture and native support for Elgato 4K Pro, 4K X and 4K S capture cards.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.short_description: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming

apps.name: OVR Overlay Translator
apps.short_description: Real-time VR translation. Via OCR, it converts foreign game and app text using machine, LLM, and offline engines, overlays results on the original, transcribes live voice into subtitles, and sends to VRChat Chatbox. 30 languages, multilingual UI, full controller support.

apps.name: PawPaint
apps.short_description: PawPaint is a modern 3D model painting software that has been crafted with you in mind, focused on being the best 3D painting software for VRChat avatar creators, 3d modelers and hobbyists. Featuring non-destructive layers, masks, modifiers, a bundled asset library, and game-ready export up to 4K.

apps.name: Sigilgraph
apps.short_description: A modular non-linear DAW and sandbox for sound designers and generative musicians. Connect synthesizers, sample tools, MIDI modifiers, and modulation sources on a visual canvas with virtual cables. Break free from the traditional linear timeline to construct evolving, self-playing soundscapes.

apps.name: Substance 3D Painter 2026
apps.short_description: Adobe Substance 3D Painter is the reference texturing app for 3D professionals and enthusiasts. From AAA Game Developers to Indies, from Feature Animation to Visual Effects studios, the industry uses Painter to bring their creations to life.

apps.name: VantGrid
apps.short_description: Open your Steam library, see what friends choose to share and get together over P2P voice. Games, your gaming week and earned titles in one Windows app. Buy once; friends can join through the free Friend Pass.

apps.name: vrOS
apps.short_description: vrOS puts your desktop windows on panels inside VR, with a laser pointer and a VR keyboard that work in the real window. Fix your playspace, assign and calibrate trackers, watch frame timing, and add VRChat OSC, OBS, Twitch and soundboard tools — all in one crash-resistant overlay.

apps.name: VTuber Forge
apps.short_description: Your avatar. Their chaos. Your show. Animate 2D PNGtubers and 3D VRM avatars with your webcam and mic. Let viewers throw items, change outfits and trigger effects on Twitch, YouTube and Kick. VTuber Forge brings avatar tools, chat interactions and stream controls together in one Windows app.

apps.name: VZX Player
apps.short_description: Actively developed 3D Music Visualizer - reacts in real time to the music you play, regardless of player. Free, no watermarks, no nag screens, no subscriptions. Optional DLC for more effects.

apps.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Benchmark
Angelfall Demo
apps.short_description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

apps.name: Arctic Drive Demo
apps.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

apps.name: ASEMA Demo
apps.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

apps.name: Aveos Demo
apps.short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

apps.name: Backrooms Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: Backrooms Protocol Demo is a walk simulator designed to showcase the atmosphere and environments of the full game. It contains three different levels to explore, each featuring its own unique atmosphere.

apps.name: Band of Crusaders Demo
apps.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Demo showcases all key game mechanics, which will be further expanded upon in the game release.

apps.name: Bandidos em Brasilia Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of Bandidos em Brasília. This demo includes the story mode and the free modes! Try out a horror game featuring Brazil's most well-known politicians for free, and feel free to report any bugs or suggest improvements!

apps.name: Barnburners Demo
apps.short_description: Free 5-on-5 arcade hockey with four playable clubs, couch and online games, fights, and a ten-game Seattle Franchise trial through the playoffs and draft. Aim your shots, throw the hits, and see how far you can take the Squall.

apps.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed." Demo
apps.short_description: Demo demo demo demo demo [demo] demo | Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

apps.name: Basketball Dynasty Demo
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

apps.name: Battle Suit Aces Demo
apps.short_description: Battle Suit Aces is a charming card-battling RPG. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

apps.name: Beastieball Demo
apps.short_description: Coach a sports team of Beasties in this turn-based volleyball RPG! Your Beasties' relationships power up their teamwork!

apps.name: Beltrunner Demo
apps.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

apps.name: Benson Bones Demo
apps.short_description: You claw out of a grave with no memory, and a friendly dog named Benson finds you. Benson Bones is a top-down pixel art adventure RPG with timing-based combat, Souls-style checkpoints and a hand-built world of doors that open where they shouldn't.

apps.name: Black Ledger: The Antique Mafia Demo
apps.short_description:
Run an antique shop during the day.

Lead a criminal organization at night.

Maintain a balance between profit, loyalty, and suspicion... Every choice has consequences.

apps.name: BlastMorph: Pinball Demo
apps.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it!  Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

apps.name: blockia Demo
apps.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo. Free demo with selected parts.

apps.name: Brothers Demo
apps.short_description: A cooperative medieval action game where you and your brother fight through dangerous environments, take on powerful enemies, and grow stronger together. Brothers serves as the foundation and showcase for a much larger co-op experience currently in development.

apps.name: Bug Ball Demo
apps.short_description: Bug Ball is a wacky football (soccer) game where you play as little bugs.

apps.name: Bumper & Thumper Demo
apps.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

apps.name: Call The Exterminator Demo
apps.short_description: When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours. CTE is classic 90's 2.5D action. Suit up, Light up, its time to Call The Exterminator.

apps.name: Carry On Together Demo
apps.short_description: Get your first taste of moving chaos in Carry On Together Demo! Play online co-op with up to 4 players, carry furniture together, drive the truck and try to complete the delivery without turning everything into a disaster.

apps.name: Celtreos Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo!  1-2 players, game controller support.  Great music!  Tons of weapons, guards & special moves.  3-stage demo (more than 12 in full game), partly-random, with bosses.  Play in a window or in Full Screen.

apps.name: Chimpanik Demo
apps.short_description: Chimpanik is a chaotic PvP party game where your voice is your only weapon! Play as an armless monkey, scream into your microphone to unleash shockwaves, and battle up to 8 other players in randomly generated arenas. Anything can happen!

apps.name: Cleaner Company Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo of Cleaner Company, a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean up the Flying Canteen, a space restaurant infested by friendly mutant chickens and unfriendly alien pests.

apps.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3 Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: play ValuCo #3's first five days for real. Throw crates onto empty shelves, chain register combos, wrangle cart trains, survive corporate's nightly "improvements." Your progress carries into the full game: six more stores, starting with one that never closes.

apps.name: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

apps.name: DeadFront Demo
apps.short_description: DeadFront Demo is a 1-to-6 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

apps.name: Diatonic Demo
apps.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

apps.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar Demo
apps.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

apps.name: Don't Fool Me, Beauties! Demo
apps.short_description: "Get out!!!" Kicked out in the dead of winter, you land a job at a shady hotel. But work’s not the only challenge, there’s the CEO’s cold-hearted granddaughter, a lazy senior, a diva model, and your childhood friend who makes you do her laundry?! Which captivating woman will you win over?

apps.name: Dragons Invasion Demo
apps.short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

apps.name: Drop Command Demo
apps.short_description: Classic '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build a Mech empire and conquer the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds. You are the battlefield commander leading from the cockpit.

apps.name: Echoes of Nothing Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver your enemies, then retaliate with lasers and heavy artillery.

apps.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil Demo
apps.short_description: Atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring a fantasy world through magical portals. Explore the first location, collect rare equipment, and discover the world of Sunveil.

apps.name: Emptiness Sire Demo
apps.short_description: Three survivors in a world consumed by cosmic horror. Solve turn-based puzzles and face deadly enemies, because death is part of the journey, but you can undo its consequences.

apps.name: Escape the Exomoon Demo
apps.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

apps.name: Faith of Fate Demo
apps.short_description: Faith of Fate, a demo made by half million dreams for a half million testers. if you just have half Faith then you'll get just half Fate, good luck <3

apps.name: Fieldmade Demo
apps.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

apps.name: Frontier Tavern Demo
apps.short_description: Run a tavern in the Old West in this first-person demo. Pour drinks, serve customers, restock supplies and hire your first employees. Unlock whisky, improve your tavern and learn to defend it. Keep playing after completing the demo's missions.

apps.name: Ghoul Fright Demo
apps.short_description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based action-packed FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves.¿Ready to Fright?

apps.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard Demo
apps.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

apps.name: Global Parity Demo
apps.short_description: Try Global Parity for free: take charge of a nation in 1999 and steer it through its first years. Balance the budget, pass laws, survive elections and crises, and face AI neighbours who build, scheme and fight. Wishlist the full game!

apps.name: Greedy Getaways Demo
apps.short_description: Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh every excursion.

apps.name: Grimoire of Blanks Demo
apps.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks with words, build devastating combos, and play through the first act with 2 of the 4 classes. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Hauntbound Demo
apps.short_description: An online and local multiplayer horror party game for 2 to 8 players. Explore a haunted house that builds itself, search for relics, avoid deadly traps, and compete in chaotic minigames before the haunt begins.

apps.name: Jet Birds Demo
apps.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

apps.name: Kaiju Defense Project Demo
apps.short_description: Kaiju Defense Project is a strategy game set in a distant world where humanity is fighting to survive against hordes of giant monsters: the Kaijus. Research, manage, and strategically build your defenses to keep humanity alive on this planet. How much time does humanity have left?

apps.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Demo
apps.short_description: No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!

apps.name: Memoria Wake Demo
apps.short_description: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this Souls-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.

apps.name: MeowRig Demo
apps.short_description:
MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game.
Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

apps.name: Merc Commander Demo
apps.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

apps.name: Mithril Demo
apps.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

apps.name: Mokomon: Five Elements Demo
apps.short_description: A Roguelike Auto Battler focused on creature taming and evolution. Choose your Tamer, master the Five Elements system, and break the game by discovering new evolutions and insane synergies to annihilate hordes, defeat bosses, and outmatch other players' builds.

apps.name: Moorhuhn Kart 4 Demo
apps.short_description: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack!  Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

apps.name: MVX: London Demo
apps.short_description: Save London in a shared-world co-op shooter set in a 1:1 recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons and mysterious Flux powers.

apps.name: Nioh 3 Demo
apps.short_description: In the third game in the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh, you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open field.

apps.name: No Mercy Demo
apps.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

apps.name: No One Left To Die Demo
NO SUNRISE Demo
apps.short_description: Survive twelve zombie waves in an abandoned cinema, alone or in co-op with up to four players. Buy weapons, repair barricades and unlock more rooms. This NO SUNRISE Alpha demo ends after wave 12 and includes German and English in-game text.

apps.name: No Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers across Camp Crestwood, unlock nine brutal weapons, weaponize a fully destructible map, and survive an escalating response in this free playable slice of No Survivors. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

apps.name: Nonogram Detective Demo
apps.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

apps.name: Nutshot Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

apps.name: ODD ODDS Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

apps.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword DEMO
Online Boxing 3D Demo
apps.short_description:
A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. 
Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

apps.name: Palisade Demo
apps.short_description: Command territory directly with no squads to micromanage. Try Palisade’s real time strategy in a free solo campaign with three linked battles. Expand across the Nordic countries, land in Britain, and fight for the Seine.

apps.name: PatchWorld Demo
apps.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

apps.name: Pawn Pleasure Demo
apps.short_description: Step into a world populated entirely by women as the owner of your own shop. Buy low, sell high, and build your shop. When the  price isn't enough, "negotiate" intimate deals to seal the trade. Expand your business, hire beautiful staff, and explore a city where every encounter leads to pleasure.

apps.name: Penko Vox: Japanese Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Penko Vox: Japanese. Start your voyage in Hajimari Town: talk to residents in your own words, call them by voice, catch word spirits on Route 1 and get gentle corrections, all fully offline on your PC. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Picker Magnate Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

apps.name: PSYCHO DEAD Demo
apps.short_description: Uncover a chilling third-person survival horror adventure. Take the role of a girl with psychic powers, desperate to escape a secret lab while pursued by deadly stalkers. The demo includes the game’s opening sequence.

apps.name: Punch Upon a Time Demo
apps.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

apps.name: Ragnarok Roads Demo
apps.short_description:
Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle
  battles on frozen roads. This is a retro-style strategy game, rewarding the planning, perceptive and persistent players, like games used to be.

apps.name: RAT TAG! Demo
apps.short_description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

apps.name: Red Father Demo
apps.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

apps.name: REOGUNA Demo
apps.short_description:
This is the demo version of "REOGUNA." You can try out the tutorial, the early stages, and a portion of the level editor.
Stage completion data can be carried over to the full version.

apps.name: Risewards Demo
apps.short_description: Solve tons of puzzles using logic, physics and (why not) by tricking the game itself. Sometimes the solution may be obvious to you, other times you'll need to think outside the box to progress, or maybe hack your own way to skip a puzzle. Just don't fall into the void... unless you should? ;)

apps.name: Rollamon Demo
apps.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

apps.name: Rune Dice Demo
apps.short_description: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

apps.name: RV Life Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Drive, customize, and live in your camper as you explore an open world full of adventure.

apps.name: Sealing Fallout Demo
apps.short_description: A fusion reactor has blown up and it's up to sealkind to save Earth from the ensuing Runaway Electron Avalanche! Group up with up to 6 fellow seals to fix the reactor before the seventh day ends. The AI Adam predicts your failure, prove it wrong and blow it up.

apps.name: She Was King Demo
apps.short_description: A dark, witchy pixel-art RPG dungeon crawler about hexed bonds, curious creatures, and finding your way home. Run, as fast as you can. Can you outfox what's coming, or will you let it consume you?

apps.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

apps.name: SKINFACE Demo
apps.short_description: SKINFACE is a short-and-punchy stealth game where you embody a faceless hitman who needs to steal the faces of others to gain the trust of their target. Set in dark soviet-era apartment complexes, evade the police and get your victim to open up the door for you. Knock, knock!

apps.name: Skingdom Demo
apps.short_description: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

apps.name: Skullf! Demo
apps.short_description:
You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf!

After yet another hilarious night terrorizing locals, it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

apps.name: Soliton Burst Demo
apps.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

apps.name: Starless Umbra Demo
apps.short_description: Starless Umbra is a story-rich action RPG inspired by the best of classic and modern JRPGs. Engage in real-time combat and explore puzzle-filled dungeons in a couch co-op adventure where friendship and loyalty are tested in a world consumed by a noxious fog.

apps.name: Stars of Icarus Demo
apps.short_description: From the creators of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Form your team and pilot, repair, and man the guns on your ship. Victory or death, together.

apps.name: StickType Demo
apps.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

apps.name: Super Mining Mechs Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

apps.name: SUPERPANEL DEMO
apps.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

apps.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Three days behind the counter of a traditional Turkish tea house. Brew cay, grill toasties, run trays out to the shopkeepers on the street, and keep the okey corner from turning into a fight. Around half an hour, online co-op for 1-6 players, and the first day teaches you everything.

apps.name: Thalassomania Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op PS1 horror on a North Sea trawler for 1-4 players. Fish, steer through the storm, keep the engine alive and watch the cameras while the jobs split you up. There's one more aboard than there should be, and you'll hear it before you see it.

apps.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings Demo
The Cup: Creature Card Battler Demo
apps.short_description: The demo of The Cup, a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler. Play THE ROAD: five cases against invasive species, back to back. Draft as you go, and a creature knocked out is gone for the road. Learn from the booth in one tutorial match, then take on the House. Plays fully offline.

apps.name: The Grander Demo
apps.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

apps.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410 Demo
apps.short_description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

apps.name: The Runesmith Demo
apps.short_description: Explore ancient lands, gather rare materials, and forge powerful runes blessed by mighty gods. Craft, hunt, mine, and master the art of runesmithing: a fallen god’s path to reclaim his place among the divine.

apps.name: The Shaman Diary Demo
apps.short_description:
A story-driven turn-based RPG with deep strategy and rich gameplay.
Explore a vast heroic fantasy world, master skills, gear up, and forge your own path.
The Ravagers are closing in. Will you protect Astreia?
Experience the opening chapters of an epic story inspired by a 650-page original novel.

apps.name: Thousands of Chroma Demo
apps.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

apps.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion Demo
apps.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

apps.name: TRACE Demo
apps.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

apps.name: Train of Thought Demo
apps.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

apps.name: Tropico 7 - Demo
apps.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

apps.name: Twilight Requiem Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the opening chapter of Twilight Requiem, a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by classic fast-paced combat systems. Battle through a cursed realm, unlock powerful abilities, and face your first major boss in this playable demo.

apps.name: UVSU Demo
apps.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

apps.name: Uyar Party Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into the chaos of Uyar Party! Compete in fast-paced minigames, outplay your rivals, and survive unpredictable arenas with up to 8 players online or against AI. The demo gives you a taste of the full party experience.

apps.name: VantGrid Demo
apps.short_description: Join one friend who owns VantGrid for free. Chat, join their calls and groups, and watch their shared screen. Friend Pass is a guest experience, not the full application.

apps.name: Void Inc Demo
apps.short_description: Try 14 in-game days of a darkly funny workplace management sim with creeping horror. Plan the workload, clear emails to the beat, and decide who gets the coffee. Keep the CEO happy and your sanity intact. You're on the schedule too.

apps.name: War Asunder Demo
apps.short_description: A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades.

apps.name: Wasteland Bites Demo
apps.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

apps.name: Watch Party: Watch the web together Demo
We Are Rebellion Demo
apps.short_description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

apps.name: WE'RE ALL IN! Demo
apps.short_description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

apps.name: What the Buck?! Demo
apps.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Worldkampf '72 Demo
apps.short_description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

apps.name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ Demo
图灵之书 Demo
apps.short_description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

apps.name: 幸福里:生门 Demo
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game where every door is a decision. Read the clues, follow the rules, and choose carefully inside a research facility that rebuilds itself every run. Pick the wrong door—and whatever is waiting in the dark comes for you.

apps.name: American Truck Simulator - Kansas
apps.short_description: Introducing Kansas! A U.S State that is home to a truly authentic cowboy culture and miles of land littered with wildflowers. Located in the Midwest of the USA, Kansas is known for its native grasslands, streams, abundant blue skies, and green grassland vistas.

apps.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - Additional mode "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX"
apps.short_description: "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

apps.name: Batman Noir
apps.short_description: Batman - The Telltale Series Shadows Mode brings a captivating new look to the storied Telltale Batman games. Enhanced with hand recolored gameplay and remastered textures, replay your favorite Telltale Batman episodes and experience the twisted world of the Dark Knight in a sinister, new way.

apps.name: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass
apps.short_description: Extend the lunar mayhem with the Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass featuring new characters, challenges, missions, and more! Harness the power of your good looks with the “Handsome Jack” Character Pack; raise your level cap & battle waves of enemies in The Holodome Onslaught; and two more add-on Packs!

apps.name: ChineseParents DLC - eSports
apps.short_description: Chase e-sports glory in a new story! Join a team and compete for the championship, with new courses, daily activities, career paths and endings shaped by your tournament results. Clear the story to unlock a character you can befriend and romance.

apps.name: COLLEC — Patron
apps.short_description: Everything in the Collector's Edition, plus the Patron frame and title, and your name on the game's list of patrons.

apps.name: Conan Exiles Enhanced: Isle of Siptah
apps.short_description: Isle of Siptah is a massive expansion to the open world survival game Conan Exiles, featuring a vast new island to explore, huge and vile new creatures to slay, new building sets and a host of new features.

apps.name: ContractVille - Rent Expansion
apps.short_description: Bring the real estate business to ContractVille with the Rent Expansion! Buy houses, decorate them with your furniture, and lease them to various tenants. Includes new property management mechanics to build your passive income.

apps.name: Crosstalk: The Bloat and Greed Edition
apps.short_description: This DLC delivers pre-compiled binaries for the x86 architecture. The delivered content matches the main app ID with the difference that in this DLC, the player gets ready-to-play executables, versus the main app ID's source.

apps.name: DAVE THE DIVER - GGST Content Pack
apps.short_description: LET'S ROCK! Experience the explosive energy of GGST in DAVE THE DIVER.

apps.name: Desktop Mate 琴葉葵 DLC
apps.short_description: Voice-synthesis character Kotonoha Aoi joins Desktop Mate! The polite, level-headed younger twin reacts with a surprised "!" on click, scatters petals on jumps, and her ribbon bursts into petals when patted. With "Kotonoha Akane DLC," enjoy Combo Actions—waving, startle reactions, and Combo Alarm!

apps.name: Far Cry 6 DLC 2 Pagan: Control
apps.short_description: Become the villain as you step into the flamboyantly eccentric mind of Pagan Min from Far Cry® 4.

apps.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Typhon Map Pack
apps.short_description: Map pack for Heroes of Science and Fiction! 7 new custom scenarios, each one with its own twist on the standard HoSaF map formula. The maps also showcase new content from the latest game updates, including underground map layer, new items and neutral units.

apps.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Xenauri faction
apps.short_description: Lead the Xenauri, a nomadic warrior faction of lizard-riders and psychic altari, as they invade the Siren System. Experience the aftermath through two narrative-focused levels led by a young Xenauri commander.

apps.name: Immortals Fenyx Rising – The Lost Gods
apps.short_description: Discover a new top-down gameplay experience featuring a daring new champion and brawler-style combat!

apps.name: Kaiju Princess 2 Artbook
apps.short_description: Dive into the Kaiju Princess 2 art book and uncover the secrets behind its character designs, planetary aesthetics, and interstellar feasts!

apps.name: Killing Floor 3 Future Seasons 2-4 Deluxe Pass
apps.short_description: Upgrade DLC for current Killing Floor 3 owners that includes future access to 3 premium Nightfall Supply Passes and 2000 Creds

apps.name: Killing Floor 3 Shadow Agent Season 1 Deluxe Pass
apps.short_description: Upgrade DLC for current Killing Floor 3 owners that includes premium Nightfall Supply Pass access, 1000 Creds, and exclusive Shadow Agents weapon and outfit skins

apps.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry Artbook
apps.short_description: The official Artbook of Leisure Suit - Larry Wet Dreams Don't Dry.

apps.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Artbook
Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails
apps.short_description: Sail the high seas, lead mighty fleets, and forge your legacy in War Sails. Bringing naval warfare to Bannerlord for the first time, War Sails lets players command powerful ships, engage in thrilling sea battles, and master maritime conquest.

apps.name: Mycopunk - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Mycopunk Supporter Pack offers additional cosmetics to players who want to help support Pigeons at Play and future development of Mycopunk.

apps.name: PAYDAY 2: Hostile Takeover Heist
apps.short_description: Hostile Takeover Heist is available on its own or as part of the Hostile Takeover Bundle.

apps.name: Poppy Playtime - Chapter 5
apps.short_description: In the latest terrifying chapter of the Poppy Playtime saga, you are propelled further into the gruesome depths of the factory, with Playtime’s security system Huggy Wuggy in hot pursuit.

apps.name: Prison Anomaly - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Exclusive frame of Oxy (my real life Dog) for the prison as a decorative element.

apps.name: Risk of Rain 2 - Expansion 1
apps.short_description: Embrace The Void as it overtakes Petrichor V in Risk of Rain 2’s first-ever expansion! New survivors, monsters, stages, and a new class of items have arrived to help you kick the crabs back to their dimension.

apps.name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV Complete Edition Upgrade Pack
SnowRunner - Dragon Wagons Dual Pack
apps.short_description:
The Dragon Wagons Dual Pack brings 2 new trucks to your garage: the Heavy-class Avenhorn A15 and the Heavy Duty-class Padera STD-4 - as well as unique add-ons!

This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3, Year 4 or Year 5 Passes.

apps.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! - Season Pass
apps.short_description: Continue your Snow Day adventure with a Season Pass for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! which includes and all-new Game Mode, New Weapons, a Weapon Variation, and Cosmetic Packs.

apps.name: STALZONE — Memories of STALCRAFT: X
apps.short_description: Add this nostalgic STALCRAFT: X pack to your collection.

apps.name: Steam & Steel
apps.short_description: Add 16 railway and industrial jigsaw puzzles to Impression Cabinet. Assemble locomotives, bridges, rail yards, maps, technical drawings, and steelworks. Complete each Working Proof and file the finished print in a new album.

apps.name: The Bus - Hamburg City
apps.short_description: Experience the Hanseatic city from the perspective of a bus driver in The Bus - Hamburg City – get in and drive off!

apps.name: The Loopler - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Unlock cosmetics for The Loopler by showing your support

apps.name: Train Simulator: Hudson Line: New York – Croton-Harmon Route Add-On
apps.short_description: Train Simulator’s Hudson Line route delivers fast-paced and challenging American commuter, passenger, and freight railroading at its contemporary best.

apps.name: Train Simulator: Miami - West Palm Beach
Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 2
apps.short_description: Play as former OSS agent and assassin, Jessica Valiant, AKA Agent Silent Death! Hot on the trail of a sinister plot, Valiant finds herself in the offices of Paragon Pictures, Tinseltown film studio turned Nazi propaganda machine.

apps.name: Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 3
apps.short_description: Gun down Nazi enemies as US Army Captain Gerald Wilkins! On the run since the Nazi war machine leveled Manhattan with an atom bomb, Wilkins returns home to reunite with an old comrade and dismantle the deadliest weapon ever made: the Sun Gun.

apps.name: 2in1
apps.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

apps.name: 9 Fingers
apps.short_description: Play for cash. Pay with fingers. A dark card game of bluffs and counterbluffs. Face the boss solo or compete against a friend and the boss online. Use items and finger bonuses to reveal cards, steal bonuses and make a bluff harder to hide.

apps.name: A Cat's Manor
apps.short_description: Trapped in a house inhabited by a crazed family, with a hand stitched on its tail. Solve puzzles, craft items & tools, survive deadly encounters, use force or outwit bosses, hide & use stealth. Survive long enough to escape the Manor and decide how it ends.

apps.name: A Short Odyssey
apps.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

apps.name: A.I.M. War Protocol
apps.short_description: A role-playing game with survival and action-simulation elements. You are going to explore a huge world of an alien planet full of mysteries and secrets. Fight, trade, loot, evolve and collect knowledge about the world. Become the best. Survive where others die.🚀

apps.name: Abductables
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelite about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

apps.name: Abyssal Station
apps.short_description: A Lovecraftian space tower defense. Hold a station rebuilt every run against endless waves pouring from the rifts, bargain with offerings that feed the corruption, and dig deeper until the core gives out.

apps.name: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR
apps.short_description: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR is a one-of-a-kind title featuring the unique Ace Style gauge system that shifts based on how you play (Ace Style) and the choices that you make during missions.

apps.name: AEA
apps.short_description: All Eyes Above is a co-op shooter for a crew of up to four players, where your teamwork is the only thing standing between civilization and obliteration.  Join the ranks of elite soldiers and fight a ruthless faction in a moving battlefield across an epic 10 mission campaign.

apps.name: Afterconflict
apps.short_description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

apps.name: Afterwork Apocalypse
apps.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

apps.name: Age of Harvest
apps.short_description: Age of Harvest is a deep 2D simulation traditional Roguelike. Explore a living world, manage your body and wounds, and survive an ever-changing world as you uncover its mysteries and bring about the true Age of Harvest.

apps.name: Ai-Breakout
apps.short_description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

apps.name: Aleph's Garden
apps.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

apps.name: Alien Prospectors
apps.short_description: Head out onto an alien planet with a drill, a scanner and a limited supply of air. Dig up over a thousand different finds, sell them at headquarters, and upgrade your way to the deepest, rarest deposits, on your own or alongside other prospectors. Stay hydrated!

apps.name: Altitude Zero
apps.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

apps.name: Anti-anti
apps.short_description: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

apps.name: ANU
apps.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

apps.name: Arcade City
apps.short_description: Welcome to Arcade City, the ultimate gaming paradise where the fun never stops... or does it? Tackle 2D pixel-art minigames while uncovering disturbing anomalies hidden inside. Keep playing, stay focused, and whatever you do, don't stop being happy!

apps.name: Arcane Overdrive
apps.short_description: Arcane Overdrive, is a survivor-like game where you combine different vehicle parts to create your own gameplay and movement style.

apps.name: Archi Vista
apps.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

apps.name: Arctic Station Six
apps.short_description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs to read your instruments, warn of gales, launch weather balloons, send out a drone and more. Grow the site level by level from a small outpost to a fully fledged research station.

apps.name: ASEMA
apps.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

apps.name: Ashes of the Swarm
apps.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

apps.name: Athanasia
apps.short_description: Fight the past in Athanasia, an immersive horror FPS set in an abandoned research facility overrun with prehistoric predators. Outwit nature, delve deep and uncover the facility's mysteries.

apps.name: AUREUS GEMWORKS ― リリトリオンの宝石工場
apps.short_description: Build a gem factory, one card at a time. Combine factory automation with deckbuilding as you mine, refine, transport and ship precious gems. Work with an eccentric crew in the abyss and meet the demands of Lilitryon, your gold-loving supervisor.

apps.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
apps.short_description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

apps.name: B.L.U.E. NOVA
apps.short_description: B.L.U.E. NOVA is an online co-op PvE third-person shooter that grows from solo play into battles with up to 30 players. Choose your hero, connect through “R.I.N.G.”, unleash “Infinite Barrage,” and join forces to destroy the final “Master Tower”!

apps.name: Bach Rediscovered
apps.short_description: A music jigsaw puzzle where the finished picture is Bach. Listen to scattered phrases, fit the voices together, and hear the composition take shape. From a single melody to interwoven fugues, put your musical ear to work.

apps.name: Band of Crusaders
apps.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

apps.name: Bannerlings
apps.short_description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

apps.name: Barnburners
apps.short_description: 5-on-5 arcade hockey with huge hits, dirty dangles and top shelf goals. Pick from 24 fictional clubs, build a Franchise, take the game outdoors, or face friends in couch and online head to head play.

apps.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
apps.short_description:
Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books...
Until her eyes fell out.
You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression.
There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

apps.name: Behelade
apps.short_description: Fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up, consisting of 5 stages full of beautiful, intricate patterns and bosses. Wield the magic sword “Behelade” to find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the forest creatures go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

apps.name: Beltrunner
apps.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

apps.name: BIGGER BANG
apps.short_description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

apps.name: Black Autumn: 1438
apps.short_description: A realistic medieval pixel art RPG set in the Hron valley in the autumn of 1438. Fight in armour you put on piece by piece, ride horses into battle, pick locks and purses, and gamble with cards or dice. No magic and no monsters, only the real Hron valley as it was in 1438.

apps.name: Blendead
apps.short_description: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

apps.name: blockia
apps.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

apps.name: BloodSpiller
apps.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

apps.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
apps.short_description: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

apps.name: Borregada o Facto
apps.short_description: Borregada or Facto is a quiz about current affairs, politics, history, and society. Answer questions, earn points, use cards and bonuses, and compete with your friends. Uncomfortable questions, real facts, and sources to check them yourself.

apps.name: Borrowed Flesh
apps.short_description: A deck-building roguelike of body horror where your whole party shares one deck: when a hero falls, every card they own dies with them. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, survive permanent mutilation and unraveling minds, and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

apps.name: BoteK.O.
apps.short_description: Start a band, run your bar and fight to the beat! BoteKO is a co-op rhythm beat ’em up for up to 4 players where every hit lands on the beat of your own instrument. Play locally or online, nail the timing and turn every brawl into a show.

apps.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
apps.short_description: Bounce On is back! Roll and bounce your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress. Dozens of challenging platform levels to explore to find all the secrets.

apps.name: Bowlbo: The Quest for Bing Bing
apps.short_description: A sinister Witch has kidnapped your beloved Bing Bing. You must travel the sweeping lands of Cósta Cré and do what it takes to get your poochingus back from the Nightmare Realm!

apps.name: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira
apps.short_description: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira is a fighting game that features capoeira as its main fighting style. In this game, you'll experience numerous characters and ways to fight capoeira. Let's get moving!

apps.name: Brewalmighty
apps.short_description: Turn a bucket in a garden shed into the only brewery in town. Brew, bottle and sell door to door, sabotage the lager monopoly, rob the competition and outrun the consequences, alone or with mates who are, legally speaking, "volunteers". Nice garage.

apps.name: Bugulon 12
apps.short_description: Bugulon 12 is an performant incremental idle RPG with a near endless grind. Operate a bunker on the titular planet: collect resources, level skills, and unlock new bunker frames, weapons and hardpoints. Play it active, idle, or anywhere in between.

apps.name: Bumper & Thumper
apps.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

apps.name: Capybara Dungeon
apps.short_description: Become a capybara and brave dangerous dungeons with up to 4 players. Dodge traps, face strange creatures and survive the chaos together, online or in local split-screen. A cooperative adventure where every mistake becomes a story.

apps.name: Carpoli - Car Board Game
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, drive across living 3D maps and build a car empire. Buy cars and businesses, collect rent, race rivals for their cars and fill your garage with prestige. A fast, friendly board game for 2–4 players: against bots, on one PC or online with friends.

apps.name: Cat and Paste!
apps.short_description: A chaotic copy-and-paste hide-and-seek with cats that can turn into anything. "Copy" a stage object to transform into it, then "Paste" decoys everywhere to hide in plain sight! A prop hunt party game for up to 16 players online!

apps.name: CATCAR Pit Crew
apps.short_description: Be the pit crew of a race team. Jack the car, wrench off the wheels, swap tires and refuel by hand while the race keeps going. Co-op with friends. Things will catch fire.

apps.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

apps.name: Cats Here
apps.short_description: 😺 Discover 100+ hidden cats 🐾 in the colorful landscape. 🏆 Earn TONS OF ACHIEVEMENTS. How many cats 🐈 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

apps.name: cenker's mod
apps.short_description: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

apps.name: Chase Buddies
apps.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

apps.name: Cheese Racers
apps.short_description: Thread a hovering wheel of cheese through gaps that never stop tightening. A hit costs a slice; dodge clean and it grows back. Chase your best, race everyone on the Daily Seed, and beat friends and ranked rivals on the exact same course. Earn skins, shapes, trails and maps as you play.

apps.name: Chess Duel
apps.short_description: Bring chaos to the chessboard. Choose your powers, spend stone points, shield a piece or recall a fallen queen. Face Steam friends, AI rivals and tournaments in atmospheric 3D chess, with separate Classic and Chaos ranked ladders. Medieval combat is now in private testing.

apps.name: Chess War
apps.short_description: Chess War brings chess to life in epic 3D battles between legendary armies from different historical eras. Challenge friends online or locally, face a competitive AI, and watch every capture unfold through dynamic, action-packed combat animations.

apps.name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos
apps.short_description: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set in 500 AD Oman. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s most enigmatic stories, including The Nameless City and Nyarlathotep, it pulls you into a chilling investigation of cosmic horror and creeping madness.

apps.name: Claw & Order
apps.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

apps.name: Clayverse
apps.short_description: Embark on an epic quest in the extraordinary world of Clayverse. Mold your clay hero, master crafting, and explore a mesmerizing multiverse. Engage in tactical clay combat inspired by classic MMORPGs, and experience gory claymation for a thrilling, darkly humorous twist.

apps.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
apps.short_description: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, seven stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Click Bait
apps.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

apps.name: Click Start
apps.short_description: Click Start is a branching visual novel with over 25 hours of story content about relationships, boundaries, and consequences. Meet four heroines and discover multiple endings—what matters is not only who you choose, but how you treat others along the way.

apps.name: Click! Make Zombie!
apps.short_description: You click! You make zombies! You upgrade your zombies until there are so many of them you forget what you were even doing and just watch them swarm around the hapless humans in a gigantic tsunami of destruction until the whole map is nothing but little marching zombies doing fun zombie things.

apps.name: Clicky Islands
apps.short_description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

apps.name: Climb the Fools
apps.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

apps.name: Coffee Keeper
apps.short_description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

apps.name: Coins Must Be Made
apps.short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

apps.name: Companion Baduk
apps.short_description: Learn and master Go (Baduk/Weiqi) with unique AI companions, custom game analysis with move explanations, ranked puzzles, joseki training, and a rich proverb database. Play, practice, and improve your skills at your own pace!

apps.name: Copy Cats
apps.short_description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

apps.name: Corala: Deity's Loom
apps.short_description: Corala: Deity's Loom is a dark-fantasy action-adventure game with puzzling dungeons, tense combat, and a 2000's inspired visual style.

apps.name: Cornerfall
apps.short_description: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

apps.name: Corrupted Dice
apps.short_description: A dice roguelite where even your best dice break. Unlock upgrades across runs, combine dice and relics, reshape your collection at the Black Market, and wager in minigames while keeping heat and corruption under control.

apps.name: Cosmos Knights - Abyss Survivors
apps.short_description: Defend the worlds of the Gaia Empire against the threat of the Abyss in this pixel-art action survival roguelite. Battle hordes of creatures, combine powerful abilities, grow stronger with every run, and defeat formidable bosses.

apps.name: COVR
apps.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

apps.name: Cozy Castle
apps.short_description: Cozy Castle is a hand-crafted castle diorama you tend like a little world in a jar — warm rooms, shifting seasons, and the quiet company of visitors passing through. No timers, no pressure, just a calm place to make your own.

apps.name: Crown & Applause
apps.short_description: Your boss is a Dragon King. Your audience has tomatoes. Play a mouse jester in this comic narrative rhythm game set to bardcore: hit the beat and keep the candles burning, then choose whether to please the Crown, the Crowd, or Yourself. The job comes with several possible endings.

apps.name: Curse of Resthaven
apps.short_description: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

apps.name: Custimity
apps.short_description: Free-to-play online arena Action RPG: fight PvE waves, duel players in PvP, and build powerful skill and item loadouts. Between clashes, bet on rival fights — read builds, trust your instincts, and turn sharp calls into gold. Survive, outplay, and climb the ranks.

apps.name: Daughter of Voodoo
apps.short_description: Daughter of Voodoo is a single player narrative horror experience where the dead are more than monsters. Investigate hauntings, uncover the truth behind lost lives, and perform voodoo rituals to help restless spirits find peace. Some souls seek understanding. Others refuse to let go.

apps.name: Dead Party
apps.short_description: On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood rises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders!

apps.name: Death To The Deathless
apps.short_description: 《Death To The Deathless》is an adventure game featuring lightweight roguelike elements. It combines deck-building with slot machine mechanics for combat. This game contains no real-world monetary gambling or microtransactions whatsoever.

apps.name: Debauchery & Magic
apps.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

apps.name: Deep Frost
apps.short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

apps.name: Defense Of Legends
apps.short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

apps.name: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER
apps.short_description: Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more you die, the stronger you become! Raising RTA Simulation RPG has arrived! Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!

apps.name: DenimDoug_909
apps.short_description: Follow Denim, a blue dog, on a bizarre adventure filled with strange characters, unexpected choices, and plenty of random outcomes. This animated FMV point-and-click game features 20+ different endings, and every choice can lead somewhere unexpected!

apps.name: Departure of Darkness
apps.short_description: Emma is forced to clear a horrifying parasite-infested airport as she fights to save her brother. In this 90s style Retro Survival Horror, you’ll have the option to save or leave behind fellow survivors during your adventure. However, your choices will have consequences...

apps.name: DERELIKT
apps.short_description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

apps.name: Destined Dungeon Quest
apps.short_description: By tracing lines across matching tiles on the gameboard to battle foes and gather resources, Dungeon Quest delivers a dungeon‑crawling turn‑based RPG with an old‑school soul. Explore the depths, uncover secrets, gather loot, and grow your arsenal of unique abilities.

apps.name: Die Trying
apps.short_description: Plunge into a world ravaged by the dead in this hilarious co-op shooter. Blending silly antics with open-world sandbox freedom. Escape with a plethora of loot, or Die Trying!

apps.name: Diggems
apps.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

apps.name: DIGITAL EXORCIST
apps.short_description: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississippi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

apps.name: Dirty Mop
apps.short_description: Your father vanished from this building years ago. Now you're their janitor — and the master key opens every door. Snoop, scheme, and seduce your way to the truth in this isometric adult adventure where every secret you uncover becomes your favorite new toy.

apps.name: Disc Treks
apps.short_description: Disc Treks is a sandbox disc golf game with exploration, gathering, course modification and building.  Intuitive physics-based gameplay that captures the feel of the disc flight.

apps.name: Distant Trails
apps.short_description: Explore open forest, steep mountains and muddy singletrack in this easy-paced outdoor adventure. Take a crew of trail runners out to remote locations to repair damage, protect nature and investigate unexpected events with only their feet for transport and a backpack to carry supplies.

apps.name: Dodge Mayhem
apps.short_description: Dodge Mayhem is a fast-paced top-down arena game about dodging, grabbing, charging, and throwing.

apps.name: DomeLand
apps.short_description: Leaving the city behind, driving a pickup truck to a remote wilderness to build a dome farm from scratch. Hand-fabricating components, erecting shelters, growing crops, and running an aquaponics system, then bringing the harvest straight to the farm table.

apps.name: Dominoir
apps.short_description:
Dominoir is a domino roguelike where every tile can make—or break—your run. Build clever chains, close wraps, stack powerful Schemes and Marks, and chase outrageous scores. Outsmart the House, bend its rules, and prove that at this table, luck is only the beginning.
Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

apps.name: DON'T LET THEM BOARD!
apps.short_description: It's 21XX. AI rules the world, and every morning humanity is crammed onto commuter trains bound for a life of servitude. Pick one of six oddball heroes, then punch, kick and blast the crowd off the platform before the doors close. Chaotic action with online co-op for up to 3 players.

apps.name: Doughby
apps.short_description: Doughby, a little donut with a hole lot of heart, left home to collect the strangest things in the world of Torlo. Carry them. Throw them. Put them somewhere stupid. Explore abstract, odd puzzles in this wordless, harmless comedy.

apps.name: Down Range
apps.short_description: Experience a tactical shooter that blends arcade and realism! Choose between 2 game modes and jump straight into combat solo or with friends on the battlefield, or use a game master mode to build your own scenario. Customize weapons, uniforms, gear, and gameplay parameters. Your fight, your rules!

apps.name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27
apps.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27. Build through the draft, trades and free agency, manage contracts and rotations, develop your players and create the strategy that will turn your team into a dynasty.

apps.name: Dream Broadcast Simulator
apps.short_description: Run the little TV station that broadcasts a sleeping city's dreams. Choose three dream tapes a night, fit each to its timeslot, lock the signal, and keep your Dreamers tuned in for 21 nights. A cozy strategy game built for one-more-night runs.

apps.name: DreamForge
apps.short_description: DreamForge is an AI-powered gaming platform where you create, play, and share highly personalized story adventure games. Design games, shape characters, and explore unique stories created by you and your friends.

apps.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
apps.short_description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

apps.name: Duck Duck Shoot!
apps.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

apps.name: Dumpster Divers
apps.short_description: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

apps.name: Dungeon Depths
apps.short_description:
Dungeoneer is a rouge-like, RPG, souls-like maybe future MMO game.

Taking big inspiration from Dark Souls, Runescape, Hypixels Skyblock, Metin 2 and Enter The Gungeon.

apps.name: Dungeon Lurker
apps.short_description: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

apps.name: DYTH
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

apps.name: E-Files
apps.short_description: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

apps.name: Echo Era
apps.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

apps.name: Echonox: Echoes of Heartholm
apps.short_description: ECHONOX is an online role-playing game for solo play or with friends: Fighter, Scout or Adept, eight peoples, a land full of secrets and giants only a party can defeat.

apps.name: Eclipse: Corrupted Galaxy
apps.short_description: After falling into the underground of the company where you work, you must escape while game characters come to life and hunt you down. Explore dark environments, solve puzzles, and reveal the obscure secrets of Ruzu Co. to discover the story hidden behind the scenes...

apps.name: Eggstra Tidy
apps.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Hatch helper chicks, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

apps.name: Electric Crust: Galactic Pizza Delivery
apps.short_description: Fifteen stages of side-scrolling arcade shooting, wrapped around the worst pizza delivery route in the galaxy. Bullet patterns, boss tiers, and a rank ladder Ace never asked for. One-time purchase. No ads. No IAP. No data collection.

apps.name: Elementys
apps.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

apps.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
