apps.short_description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and restore the ancient fortress of Sunveil.

apps.name: Endurance Motorsport Series
apps.short_description: Endurance Motorsport Series immerses you in the heart of this unique experience: get behind the wheel as a driver, but also step into the shoes of the race engineer to make crucial decisions from the pit lane.

apps.name: Envido
apps.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

apps.name: Eredian Stronghold
apps.short_description: Push lanes, capture buildings, and defend your base in this fast-paced Action RPG. Slaughter hordes of enemies, find legendary loot, and fight your way to the Stronghold of Eredian.

apps.name: Escape from Playtime
apps.short_description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

apps.name: Evac Bay 09
apps.short_description: You're trapped in the seemingly endless corridors of a space station, desperately searching for the evacuation bay 09. But the station is not as empty as it seems; you must observe for subtle, unsettling occurrences and log them if you want to move forward. Can you break the loop and escape?

apps.name: Everburning Dark
apps.short_description: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

apps.name: Everlong
apps.short_description: The storm takes the island one stone at a time, and only the last hero standing ever sees it pass.

apps.name: Evil Cabin
apps.short_description: Tocantins, Brazil, 1978. A storm chaser's car dies by an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere. The night is long, the woods are dense, and the radio keeps talking to him. First-person psychological horror.

apps.name: Fantasy World Manager
apps.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

apps.name: Farmkill Remastered
apps.short_description: Defend your newly acquired farmhouse and garden from an ever-growing zombie horde that attacks every night. Buy deadly flowers, fences, fully automatic weapons, bombs, exploding chickens and more to defend your farm at all costs!

apps.name: Farthest
apps.short_description: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

apps.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
apps.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

apps.name: Finger of Blood
apps.short_description: A classic first-person horde shooter where your weapon is your own hand. Shoot with a finger gun, parry every blow with perfect timing and riposte with knife or fists. Survive endless waves, spend souls at the trader, stack perks into brutal builds and take down enemies.

apps.name: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion
apps.short_description: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion is a fast-session rogue-like in which sitting on your throne allows you to reign over the battlefield.

apps.name: First Person Basketball
apps.short_description: First-person online basketball, from 1v1 to 5v5. Drive past defenders, find an open teammate, or finish at the rim. Simple controls: just WASD, Space and the mouse. Play with friends, challenge the AI, or practice your shot.

apps.name: Flempire
apps.short_description: Flempire is a mix of 1. person action shooting and RTS in a fantasy world. Switch between having the full overview of the entire battlefield, constructing buildings, controlling groups of units, or choose to be in the middle of it, become a rank-an-file unit or a hero with special abilities.

apps.name: FLICKSHOT
apps.short_description: FLICKSHOT is a hyper-stylish physics-based fighting game focused on using recoil to blast your ship around the arena. Come for party game chaos, stay for deep competitive tech and skill expression. Ricochet around 40+ stages to a bumpin’ soundtrack with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Fred Fuches Around
apps.short_description: Fred Fuches Around is an FPS game where a guy named Fred and (almost) all of his immediate family was killed inside of his home and now the ones who fuched around will find out.

apps.name: Frequency: Chernobyl
apps.short_description: An immersive adventure game about the secrets of radio broadcasts. Take a journey to the Exclusion Zone, face the time anomaly, and solve the mystery behind the broadcasts from 1986.

apps.name: From Misfortune Comes
apps.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

apps.name: Frozen Echo
apps.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

apps.name: Gambapets
apps.short_description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

apps.name: Gambeat
apps.short_description: Start with pawns, end with clowns. Build a roster of evolving pieces, stack game-breaking stickers, and chain together absurd high scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Gambiarra Garage
apps.short_description: Gambiarra Garage is a car mechanic game inspired by 2000s Brazilian car culture. You inherit your grandfather’s garage and start from scratch, dismantling, assembling, and repairing cars with realistic systems. Improvisation, creativity, and your decisions shape every result.

apps.name: Gate Fall
apps.short_description: An astronaut falls through an ancient Gate onto an unknown world. Dig with your laser, fly with your jetpack, build a factory, help living towns… then cross the Gate: crystal lands, a floating Paradise, and three epic bosses in 2D, 3D and first person.

apps.name: GearGrit
apps.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

apps.name: Generated Hero
apps.short_description:
Combine skill parts to create your own hero!
Take your hero into the dungeon and aim to conquer all 100 floors!

apps.name: Geoplanetical
apps.short_description: A geopolitical simulation that starts on January 1, 2026, with the world as it stood that day. Govern one of 200+ nations and territories, or lead its opposition: laws, budget, elections, strikes, diplomacy, war. The other governments never wait for you. No scenarios, no end date.

apps.name: Ginga Legends
apps.short_description: A football roguelike deckbuilder with tactical depth on and off the pitch. Build your club, chain the perfect play, and climb from amateur pitches all the way to the top league.

apps.name: Global Parity
apps.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance budgets, pass laws through parliament, win elections, forge alliances and wage war on a living front line, while AI nations build, scheme and fight around you. Every decision has a price.

apps.name: Glyphtrip
apps.short_description: GLYPHTRIP is a raycast ASCII dungeon-crawling roguelike where the beat runs through the world you have to navigate. Instructions are sparse. Explanation is fleeting. The deeper you go, the less reliable either becomes.

apps.name: Gods & Liars
apps.short_description: Gods & Liars is an 8-player social deduction game of faith, deception and survival. Hidden Heretics strike at night while the Priest and Inquisitor fight to expose them. Lie, accuse, deceive and survive — because when God is watching, no one can be trusted.

apps.name: Godzone 6
apps.short_description: Build your own mutant! Each one must find their own unique way to escape the Godzone in the world's first first-person mutator - from the creators of Void Bastards and Wild Bastards.

apps.name: Good Children Say Grace
apps.short_description: My parents adopted an orphan who burned down her house. I haven't slept since my girlfriend disappeared. Now everything looks like eggs. Good Children Say Grace.

apps.name: Gotching
apps.short_description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

apps.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨
apps.short_description: A wild 1980s crime adventure where dating, dirty jobs, drag races, shootouts, and adult fun collide. Explore the city, make money, build relationships, and cause trouble as you work your way toward the biggest score of your life.

apps.name: Graveyard Orbit
apps.short_description: A relaxed space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Drift through a neon-lit megastructure. Pick it clean, tile by tile. Trade your haul for parts, experiment with your ship's build, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.

apps.name: GRAVHOUNDS
apps.short_description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

apps.name: Greedy Getaways
apps.short_description:
Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways!
Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!

apps.name: Gregor's Tithe
apps.short_description: You and up to 5 friends must raid and pillage to satisfy Gregor or face his very, very large and mighty wrath.

apps.name: Gridiron Remastered
apps.short_description: Control one player in high-octane 7v7 american football action. Compete from an immersive third-person view and work with your squad to dominate the competition. Precision physics based passing, explosive runs, and strategic coordination. This is football reimagined for competitive online play.

apps.name: GridPi: Defense 3014
apps.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

apps.name: Grimdelve
apps.short_description: The world above is gone. Guide two souls through a rotting underground and shape who they become with character traits in this grimdark role playing game. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Anyone can die, your choices matter, and people remember how you treat them.

apps.name: Grimoire of Blanks
apps.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks in your cards with words and turn the same sentence into traps, area attacks, or reckless combos. A roguelite deckbuilder for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
apps.short_description: Open packs, collect absurd Grombos, and build your own card shop. Hunt rare and shiny cards, complete your collection, and decide which treasures to keep or sell. Decorate your store, deal with peculiar customers, and hire staff to keep business running.

apps.name: HAEX
apps.short_description: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.

apps.name: Hail of Hexes
apps.short_description: Featuring five playable characters, over thirty gameplay-altering items, and over eight unique upgradeable spells, every Hail of Hexes run will be unique. Explore new builds and truly master the classic arcade combat in this hand-drawn side-scrolling shoot-em-up.

apps.name: Halloween On Goober Street
apps.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences.  With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

apps.name: Hardship
apps.short_description: Hardship is a set on a dynamic world in a strange solar system. Build your city, Design your buildings and progress through an in-depth technology tree.  Gather resources, craft tools, manage citizens’ needs, and battle the elements.

apps.name: Harmony Strike
apps.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

apps.name: Hazelton Hollow
apps.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

apps.name: Hell Dream 👺
apps.short_description: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!

apps.name: Hell: Rancor
apps.short_description: A horror walking simulator set in a Japanese residential neighborhood. At night, a mysterious vegetable stall called the "Enkon Stand" appears. They say anyone who eats its strange vegetable, "Enkon," becomes addicted and can never eat anything else. What is the truth behind the rumor?

apps.name: Heretics Amulet
apps.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

apps.name: Hero Strike
apps.short_description: All the strategy of a classic RTS with zero micro required. Draft your army from 75+ fantasy units, command a leveling Hero, and engineer formations that spawn fresh every wave. Counter your rival, seize the middle line for bonus gold, and crush the enemy Citadel in 3v3 tug-of-war battles.

apps.name: Hold On
apps.short_description: Struggle. Fall. Triumph. Hold on. A small yet grand journey across life. Simple interactions connect seemingly unrelated moments, from the microscopic to the cosmic.

apps.name: Homeguard
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

apps.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
apps.short_description: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

apps.name: Human Fall Flat 2
apps.short_description: Team up and let your creativity run wild in Human Fall Flat 2, the outrageous new sequel to the much-loved capers of everyone’s favourite physics-based human friends.

apps.name: Human Power Plant
apps.short_description: The last job left for humanity in an ultimately automated society was pedaling bicycles to generate electricity.

apps.name: Hunter Bro VR
apps.short_description: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 friends.

apps.name: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
apps.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

apps.name: Hyper Snatch
apps.short_description: A 5v5 capture the flag game built on skill-based movement, utility orbs, and ultimate abilities. Master chaining slides, dives, b-hops, and super jumps to juke defenders and run the flag home, or play tactically with team orb strategies to control the field. No guns, just tags and outplays.

apps.name: Idle of the Dead
apps.short_description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

apps.name: IdleBound
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where every skill matters. Mine, fish, chop, forge, and fight your way from a grim frontier village to a tear in reality itself, even when you're not playing.

apps.name: Igni-Qua
apps.short_description: Igni-Qua is a co-op puzzle platforming adventure where you master Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Combine elemental powers, solve environmental puzzles, overcome hazards, and battle mutated creatures together online or on your own.

apps.name: Impossible Wonders
apps.short_description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

apps.name: Impression Cabinet
apps.short_description: Jigsaw puzzles at a print workshop table. Assemble 24 archival and original prints with distinct piece cuts, free rotation, and room to build off the board. Finish each Working Proof to reveal the completed print, then file it in your Cabinet. Selected prints offer a Second Look challenge.

apps.name: Infinity Girl
apps.short_description: Infinity Girl is a high-speed rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm.

apps.name: INTUS
apps.short_description:
Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

apps.name: Ionic Drive
apps.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

apps.name: Iron Command
apps.short_description: Command a war machine from inside the battlefield. Iron Command is a classic base-building RTS — harvest, build, research, attack — playable on your monitor or in VR, where the battlefield lies in front of you and your orders go out from a tablet on your wrist.

apps.name: Iron Corbo Kung Fu Janitor
apps.short_description:
Junk-Fu-Vania. Be the broom !   

🥋  Customize your own kung fu combos.   
🥊  Flamboyant finishers.   
🧹  Sweep, sanitize, smash your way through a comical, nonlinear, post-civilization romp.

apps.name: Isekai Parlor Simulator Gold
apps.short_description: An erotic management simulator in which you build your very own monster girl parlor from the ground up!

apps.name: Isles of Krom
apps.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down extraction ARPG blending challenging visceral combat with a high-stakes extraction loop. Craft and upgrade gear for your Ward before deploying them into the perilous Krom archipelago to retrieve vital materials and halt the creeping Corruption.

apps.name: JARED
apps.short_description: 2D puzzle platformer where you are a repair droid descending into a dangerous facility. Transport fragile, broken computers along the way and help them reach the Repair Station. Solve environmental puzzles, find helpful upgrades, and unravel the facility's dark mystery.

apps.name: John Whisk
apps.short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

apps.name: Junkyard Reseller
apps.short_description: Explore abandoned junkyards, discover valuable items, clean and restore them, then sell them for profit. Expand your land, hire workers and delivery drivers, and turn a small resale operation into your own junkyard empire.

apps.name: Just another thief
apps.short_description: Join a a group of thieves stealing from the rich in a dystopian world. Navigate through enemies with style streaming your heist to the world.

apps.name: Kachow Kart Racing
apps.short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

apps.name: Kaironia
apps.short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.

apps.name: Keep Chaos
apps.short_description: Survive relentless hordes in full 3D! Keep Chaos is a fast-paced, third-person bullet-heaven roguelite. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players, master 8 distinct heroes, stack powerful upgrades, and fight to conquer the battlefield.

apps.name: Kevin's In Trouble
apps.short_description: Fight your way through unrelenting waves of enemies in this top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven. Build and upgrade your deck with powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

apps.name: Keyp It Up
apps.short_description: The mother of all slop games. Melt your brain with this hypnotic key-jingling number-go-up game, or buy it for a friend if you hate them.

apps.name: Kitty Cat Match!
apps.short_description: A match 3 game featuring cute cats (and one dog) with multiple different modes to be played solo or with up to 49 other people or friends!

apps.name: KNELL
apps.short_description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

apps.name: Knight Games
apps.short_description: Knight Games is a casual party game where you compete in minigame tournaments to reclaim a broken kingdom. Enjoy ‘knight games’ of old (like Jousting / Archery) or rediscover classic 'night games' (like Hide & Seek / Capture the Flag). Between events, explore a vast kingdom to unlock new challenges!

apps.name: Koruzan
apps.short_description: Begin as a chieftain with a few tents and a borrowed oath. Grow a clan into a march, a march into a realm — on a living map where lords scheme, caravans trade and armies march without you, and every choice you make is written into a chronicle the world remembers.

apps.name: Kulipari: United
apps.short_description: Unleash your inner warrior in this high-octane 3D Beat 'Em Up! Team up with friends in 4-player local or online co-op to defend the Amphibilands. Master unique combat styles, dodge deadly hazards, and battle the Scorpion Army in a cinematic adventure expanding the Kulipari saga.

apps.name: La Fiebre: Puerto Rico
apps.short_description: An open-world racing game inspired by Puerto Rican car culture. Customize your ride, explore island-inspired locations, and compete in realistic drag races and street events with functional timing systems and online multiplayer.

apps.name: Laser Lightshow
apps.short_description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

apps.name: LeechWire 2003
apps.short_description: It's 2003. Your modem screams, pop-ups multiply, and your shared folder is your empire. Leech files, seed them for credits, close fake virus alerts before they eat your bandwidth, and keep your LeechMessenger friends happy in this Y2K idle game.

apps.name: Let's Go Hunting
apps.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

apps.name: LFG
apps.short_description: LFG Bossing is a voxel action RPG from Bad Circuit Games. Explore a procedurally generated world solo or with friends, descend into sprawling caverns, battle powerful bosses, and hunt for rare gear. Choose Rogue, Knight, Ranger, or Mage, hit dungeons and brave the Gauntlet for unique rewards.

apps.name: Light Up the Dark
apps.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

apps.name: LITTLE MINER WORLD
apps.short_description: Mine, build, and explore! Start as a rookie and delve into the depths of the Mega-Mountain in this incremental mining game. Gather materials, construct buildings, and upgrade your miner to unravel the mystery hidden at the core and become the World’s Greatest Miner.

apps.name: Llamalandia
apps.short_description:
Llamalandia is a cozy adventure game with town-building elements, about finding your family.
Build your llama sanctuary to protect your family, raise the baby llamas, and invite other cute animals to live with you in this magical place.

apps.name: Loftia
apps.short_description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

apps.name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
apps.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

apps.name: Loot Before Dusk
apps.short_description: Cozy top-down extraction shooter. Raid the corrupted Wildwood, purify Gloamed creatures, bonk goblins and rival scavengers, and reach the exit before dusk. Then rebuild your village, trade, craft and cook. No blood, real stakes. Play solo or in online co-op with friends.

apps.name: Lords of the Fallen II
apps.short_description: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.

apps.name: Lost Camp
apps.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

apps.name: Lost Zone: Survival
apps.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

apps.name: Lucky Newt
apps.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home.

apps.name: Lust of the Dead
apps.short_description: Lust of the Dead is a first-person survival horror experience set inside the decaying St. Erebus Hospital, where a mysterious outbreak has turned desire into something far more sinister.

apps.name: Market Moe
apps.short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

apps.name: Master Builders
apps.short_description: Master Builders is a strategic building game about constructing Gothic cathedrals. Plan your worksites, win over craftsmen and guilds, secure resources, and outbuild rival master builders to create the city’s grandest landmark.

apps.name: Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite
apps.short_description: Unique playstyles bring each legend to life in the fight against Hordak’s unstoppable horde. Battle your way through a variety of diverse biomes and obstacles with every playthrough and engage in Trials of Eternia, arcade mini games for precious bonuses.

apps.name: Math Marsh
apps.short_description: Math Marsh is an arithmetic arcade game where every correct answer buys you time. Guide a fly across numbered lily pads, eat the numbers that complete each equation, and dodge hungry frogs, lizards, and spiders. Choose your operations and difficulty, then see how far you can go.

apps.name: Meadgard
apps.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

apps.name: Mecha Simultactics
apps.short_description: Hey, Pilot! Join the battle in this multiplayer tactical party fighter where everyone selects an action, then all actions play out at the same time. Customize your mech and take on your opponents with simultaneous-turn-based combat, anime-inspired replays, and online PvP.

apps.name: MECHBORN
apps.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

apps.name: Method Of Entry
apps.short_description: Method of Entry is a slow paced close quarters 5v5 tactical shooter inspired by the golden age of methodical FPS games. With no hero abilities or killstreaks, it focuses on precision gunplay, disciplined teamwork, and tactical decision making in tight, high pressure engagements.

apps.name: Metromino
apps.short_description: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

apps.name: Midnight Bakery
apps.short_description: Midnight Bakery is a first-person bakery simulator with a horror twist. Serve customers, prepare coffee, restock shelves, and customize your shop. But as the nights go by, strange events begin to unfold. Can you keep your bakery running when reality itself starts to unravel?

apps.name: Midnight Shop
apps.short_description: Seven days after your grandmother vanished, you open her shop, which only trades after midnight. Under the counter glass lies a card of house rules in her handwriting, but not all of them are hers. Keep the rules to survive the night, or break them for the strangers who come in from the rain.

apps.name: Mimic Hunt
apps.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a stealth game where you hide among a crowd of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and eliminate your assigned targets without being exposed. Players can take the role of Hiders or Hunters, working together or against each other. Play solo or online with friends.

apps.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
apps.short_description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

apps.name: Mine Away
apps.short_description: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

apps.name: Mining Days
apps.short_description: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

apps.name: Minus Sixty
apps.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

apps.name: Minutes to Meltdown
apps.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

apps.name: Modern Frankenstein
apps.short_description: Step into a modern reimagining of the Frankenstein legend and experience chilling survival horror. Battle monstrous creations, including the iconic Frankenstein's Monster. Solve supernatural puzzles created by a madman. Your job is simple agent, stop Dr. Frankenstein.

apps.name: Momentigrade
apps.short_description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

apps.name: Monster Cove
apps.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

apps.name: MoonVeil
apps.short_description:
A tense co-op PvP social deduction game for 3–12 players.
Loot by day, survive the night, uncover the werewolves — or become one.

apps.name: Mossvale
apps.short_description: Mossvale is a small online fantasy RPG where you fight monsters, collect gear, complete quests, fish, cook, trade, and grow your character in a shared pixel world.

apps.name: Mountain Rescue: Caucasus
apps.short_description: Somewhere in the snowy Caucasus, Babu needs rescuing and you're the rescue team and carry Babu home on your back. Gently.

apps.name: Moving Company Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own moving company with friends! Pack fragile items, carry heavy furniture, load the truck, and deliver everything in one piece. Play solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Earn tips, build your reputation, and grow from a small crew into the city's top movers.

apps.name: Mushroom Sweeper
apps.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedural forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens.

apps.name: My Dirty Little Lake
apps.short_description:
Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game.
With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear.
Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house.
Wildlife appreciates your work.

apps.name: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
apps.short_description: Climb a hazardous mountain that gets meaner with every ascent... until it breaks you. Master Goblin Mountaineering, including rubber-arm slingshotting and fart propulsion. Not challenging enough? Hunt down bizarre accessories to become the most 'ahem' gorgeous Goblin.

apps.name: mythorune
apps.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

apps.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
apps.short_description: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

apps.name: Network Engineer
apps.short_description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

apps.name: NeverVeil Gate
apps.short_description: NeverVeil Gate is an online multiplayer social deduction game where words are weapons and trust is fragile. Players complete tasks while an Imposter hides among them, unable to kill directly but able to summon the Gate’s entity with a secret keyword. Trust the wrong voice and the gate will answer.

apps.name: Nice Dice: Game of Throws
apps.short_description: Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!

apps.name: NightMaw
apps.short_description: A physics-driven multiplayer horror game where insatiably hungry, man-made monsters stalk, pounce, and devour each other in procedurally generated dungeons.

apps.name: No Survivors
apps.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers, battle an escalating police and military response, upgrade nine brutal weapons, and turn a fully destructible lakeside camp into your deadliest weapon. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

apps.name: NODGE
apps.short_description: Every song is a boss fight. A neon rhythm shooter where bullets, lasers and walls hit on the beat, every track brings its own monster, and one hit too many ends the song.

apps.name: Nonogram Detective
apps.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

apps.name: Northern Saga
apps.short_description:
Northern Saga is an old-school real-time strategy RPG inspired by classics like Ogre Battle.

Command your clan across real-time battlefields, construct specialized combat formations, and master combat where every positioning choice matters.

apps.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
apps.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

apps.name: NTR Clinic
apps.short_description: Once betrayed, now the temptation. Pursue forbidden relationships with four partnered women at a couples clinic. An adult NTR visual novel with a story of secrets and betrayal, beautiful illustrations, 50 animation clips, and story-linked minigame challenges.

apps.name: Nutshot Simulator
apps.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

apps.name: Oblivion Line
apps.short_description: Oblivion Line is a deckbuilding roguelike puzzle RPG set in an underground city where memories are traded. Connect drops, reshape your deck, and plan around enemy intentions. Manage your sanity and weigh difficult choices as you follow an abandoned subway line.

apps.name: ONE FLICK ～ COIN CLASH ～
apps.short_description: Flick coins, knock your opponent’s pieces off the table, and protect your 100-yen King. Build decks from coins with different sizes and weights, conquer 335 CPU stages, face nine Coin Masters, and collect all 1,005 badges. Play solo or battle a friend locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: One More Donut
apps.short_description: Transform a delicious mountain of 2,500+ donuts into ultimate visual perfection! Sort tasty treats, buy upgrades, and unwind to a cozy Lo-Fi soundtrack in this satisfying tidying simulator.

apps.name: One’s Trash Another’s Treasure
apps.short_description: You spent everything on 500,000 unclaimed cargo boxes. Now you have to open every single one. A first-person incremental game about grinding boxes, feeding a hole that never fills, and calling it a business plan. Buy tools, drones, and automation. Only 499,997 to go.

apps.name: Online Poly
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, buy world cities, and make your rivals pay the toll! Online Poly is a free online board game with cute characters, property-building battles, global rankings, and a Tile Lift map that turns the board upside down.

apps.name: Orbital Desires 🛰️
apps.short_description: Gao Chao Station was the embodiment of future wealth and prosperity, an orbital paradise for sexy women needing to escape Earth’s doomed gravity – and a place for them to find their every wanton desire tended to! Only a select few could afford it, but the thrills were worth it!

apps.name: Ordanum
apps.short_description: Ordanum is a combo centred PvP auto battler where the order of your Sigils is the driving system. Arrange and rearrange your Sigils then watch your creation play out against other players' builds.

apps.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
apps.short_description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

apps.name: P.A.L.S: Lost at Sea
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op raft survival game. After one wild night at sea, you and your friends wake up lost on a tiny raft. Fish up loot, smack flopping fish, build walls and cannons, and battle a hungry shark, storms and ridiculous bosses on the long way home.

apps.name: Pack Rush
apps.short_description: Wash cars, open packs and build your deck in a neighborhood where every shift hides something strange. Collect cards, challenge rivals and uncover mysteries in a blend of simulation, card strategy and retro horror.

apps.name: Pages of Tomorrow
apps.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

apps.name: Panda Flora
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

apps.name: Paper Shredder
apps.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

apps.name: Parking Empire Simulator
apps.short_description: Own the lot and be its valet. Park customers' cars, hang their keys and bring their cars back when they return. Grow three bays into a business that fills the whole block, with a car wash, service garage and petrol station. Play solo or in 4-player online co-op.

apps.name: PatchWorld
apps.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

apps.name: Pawperwork
apps.short_description: An idle game about a cat stamping an absurd amount of paperwork, in a window that lives on top of everything else you are doing. Collect the package, stamp what is inside, send it out. Do it all by hand until you can afford not to, then go find out who keeps sending the work down.

apps.name: PC Versus
apps.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

apps.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure
apps.short_description: Defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the changing seasons to uncover the memories of fallen stars.

apps.name: People Versus Everything
apps.short_description: It's a bird! It's a plan! It's a garbage can? Face your friends in this ridiculous cat-and-mouse free-to-play shooter. Become a prop and hide within your environment, or become a hunter. Use guns, abilities, and occasionally trains to win the game!

apps.name: Picker Magnate Simulator
apps.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

apps.name: Pinion
apps.short_description: Answer an SOS from a remote island and enter a manor consumed by a spreading nightmare. Fight transformed inhabitants, search for survivors, and uncover the truth in this first-person survival horror mystery.

apps.name: Pixel Sky Waystation
apps.short_description: On a sky island between the grassland, highland, and desert, build a place where traveling merchants can rest. Prepare lodgings and warm, steaming soup, and craft new goods from the materials they bring. As more merchants arrive, your rest stop grows into a vast trading hub for all three regions.

apps.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

apps.name: Pookie's Otherworld Tavern
apps.short_description: Trapped in a fantasy world with zero gold? Pookie needs a fortune to buy her way home. Manage a tavern, serve drinks, and charm wealthy patrons. Will you run an honest business, or do whatever it takes to get paid?

apps.name: Potato Please
apps.short_description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

apps.name: Prehistoric Pit
apps.short_description: You are the dinosaur. Everything else in the pit wants you dead. PrehistoricPit is a bullet heaven roguelite with 25 auto-firing weapons, 25 evolutions, and a hard cap of four weapon slots per run. Pick a build in the first few minutes and live with it until the meteor hits.

apps.name: Press Me Up
apps.short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

apps.name: PRIEST
apps.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

apps.name: Prisma
apps.short_description: Prisma is a captivating 2D Japanese-inspired RPG featuring innovative turn-based combat with never before seen strategic use of camera lens and filters. Your camera empowers you to manipulate the world through lenses and filters, turning battles into a mesmerizing interplay of strategy and artistry.

apps.name: Prison Anomaly
apps.short_description: Trapped in a loop in a high-security prison. Inspect cells and surroundings for anomalies, avoid monsters, and press the correct button at the end of the corridor to submit your report and make it to Block A10.

apps.name: Probably Stolen
apps.short_description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

apps.name: Project Exodus
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players in which you must hunt monsters and convert them into biomass to meet the quota for "The Ark". Collect artifacts, earn money, and buy upgrades to improve your chances of survival.

apps.name: Project Kinfield
apps.short_description: A free-to-play, cozy creature-catching adventure you share with other players. Start among the stars on the ISV Concordia or deep in the Underworld, befriend nearly 300 Kin, build a home in the wild, and follow two roads that meet at the Twinspan.

apps.name: Project Red Sun
apps.short_description: Project Red Sun is a combat flight action game that has you fighting across the world as a heroic ace against corporate armies who will spare no expense in trying to take you down. With specialized jets and weaponry, dogfight aces, airships, and more in a campaign packed with arcade gameplay.

apps.name: Project Tomorrow
apps.short_description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

apps.name: Project: Autumn
apps.short_description: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

apps.name: Prospera
apps.short_description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise  to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

apps.name: Provincia Wars
apps.short_description: Provincia Wars is a real-time strategy game inspired by the Roman Empire. Build settlements, manage resources, expand your territory, and command armies in battles for control of the provinces. Plan your economy, strengthen your forces, and lead your civilization to victory.

apps.name: Quadora
apps.short_description: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.

apps.name: Quarantine 16
apps.short_description: Quarantine 16 is a indie multiplayer infection game for up to 16 players, featuring different zombie game modes, player-created maps, and plenty of chaotic ways to play with friends.

apps.name: Quest Please!
apps.short_description: Play as an Adventurers’ Guild receptionist, reviewing adventurers’ documents while working toward a promotion. Punish those who submit forged papers and build relationships with your fellow receptionists along the way.

apps.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026
apps.short_description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

apps.name: Rent Out Together
apps.short_description: Fix up filthy homes as up to 4 players and rent them out to guests. Clean, paint, furnish every room and redesign the floor plan with a sledgehammer, then take your listing photos. Grow from one studio to seaside villas and meet 34 kinds of guests. Some leave five stars. Others trash the place.

apps.name: REOGUNA
apps.short_description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

apps.name: Requiem Of Science
apps.short_description: Requiem Of Science is a free modification for Half-Life 2: Episode 2. The key features are the eclectic level design, unusual storytelling and the madness of the developer.

apps.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
apps.short_description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

apps.name: Ricochord
apps.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite about bouncing orbs and flashing lights. And it has some music.

apps.name: RIDGERUNNERS
apps.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

apps.name: Rift Crashers
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

apps.name: Roads and Relics
apps.short_description: A co-op horror game where you have to run an antique store and find valuables in a procedurally generated world

apps.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady
apps.short_description: Plutobell is in trouble! Help Rei-Bo in this action-platformer full of challenges and traps, filled with of cute and silly characters. Choose the stage order, get new weapons as you defeat each boss and test all your skills in RoboGAL!

apps.name: Robot Basketball League
apps.short_description: Robot Basketball League is a gritty sports game featuring a modified version of 1v1 Basketball. This is where the most competitive robot athletes gather. Do you have what it takes to succeed in this League?

apps.name: Rocket League
apps.short_description: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and basketball-inspired Extra Modes, and more than 500 trillion possible cosmetic customization combinations.

apps.name: Rogue Jungle
apps.short_description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated jungle, merge powerful weapon cards into crazy builds and defeat enemy hordes and epic bosses. Open Booster Packs to unlock new Characters, Weapons and Items.

apps.name: Roomy
apps.short_description: Roomy is a customizable 3D avatar room sandbox for creating scenes, posing characters, decorating spaces, taking virtual photos, and exploring interactive environments. Customize rooms, avatars, cameras, weather, lighting, furniture, animations, and more, with support for mods and custom content.

apps.name: Rouge and Run
apps.short_description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

apps.name: Route 340
apps.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

apps.name: Rude Supermarket Simulator
apps.short_description:
Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment.
Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players.

apps.name: RuinBlade
apps.short_description: This is a small personal work. Please manage your expectations

apps.name: Sails of Salt
apps.short_description: Take the helm in this atmospheric pirate roguelite. Explore uncharted seas, shape your crew's destiny and chase fortune through roaring broadsides. Capture ships for your fleet and build a lasting legacy. Will you risk it all for greed?

apps.name: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
apps.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

apps.name: Sandweh
apps.short_description: Sandweh is a relaxing sand-surfing game set in an endless, procedurally generated desert. Carve trails through dunes, build speed, pull off flips and rolls, catch the wind with your sail, and discover mysterious towers and hidden places. No pressure, just you and your board.

apps.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
apps.short_description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

apps.name: Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
apps.short_description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

apps.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
apps.short_description: Deadly memory-altering SCPs have breached containment. Most are invisible without special equipment, and can fill your mind with hazardous knowledge…or leave you an empty husk. Scavenge, survive, and escape this procedurally-generated SCP nightmare.

apps.name: Scrapworks Inc.
apps.short_description: A PvP auto battler built from junk. Buy scrap parts, wire them together on a grid and tier them up, then watch your machine fight other players' builds on its own.

apps.name: Seashell Hoarder: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person beachcombing game where you gather, clean, and shelve thousands of seashells along a sun-warmed coastline. Sort each find into its rightful place, restore the shore, and turn a scattered coastline into a curated collection at your own pace.

apps.name: Serious Bigness
apps.short_description: Serious Bigness is a co-op kaiju destruction game for 1-4 players where you start tiny and grow by smashing everything from dominoes to skyscrapers. Explore physics-driven sandbox levels solo or with friends, online or split-screen. Race the clock, climb leaderboards, and grow big, seriously big!

apps.name: Set the Record Straight
apps.short_description: A 1998-set deduction game. Trawl a period internet for documents, photographs, and dead ends, then correct the official record, from who really played on a record to whether a murder verdict should stand. An anthology of records set straight, one careful search at a time.

apps.name: SetPoint Volleyball
apps.short_description: Chaotic beach volleyball from 2v2 to 6v6! Play online with up to 12 players or with up to 4 on one PC. Nail spikes, prank your teammates and dodge tsunamis, lava and a hungry gator. Bots fill empty spots. Save your best plays and funniest fails as video clips.

apps.name: SG Racing
apps.short_description: Four animals and a robot have been given racing cars. This was a mistake. SG Racing is a fast, ridiculous pixel-art arcade racer about tight corners, power-ups and deeply irresponsible use of eggs.

apps.name: Shadows of Ambition
apps.short_description: Step into a dark, choice-driven visual novel where ambition, lust, and power collide. Build relationships, shape your future, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a world driven by desire and corruption.

apps.name: Shadows of Beginnings
apps.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

apps.name: Shape Gomoku
apps.short_description: Who says five stones have to form a straight line? Build target shapes in this fresh take on Gomoku. Challenge Easy or Hard BOTs, play locally with a friend, or invite a Steam friend online. Explore Classic, five-minute Race, and Secret Targets modes, plus 23 puzzles.

apps.name: SheepTag: Dragons
apps.short_description: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning escapes and close calls. Run. Hide. Outwit.

apps.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
apps.short_description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

apps.name: Skill Eater
apps.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

apps.name: Slime Slasher
apps.short_description: You take on the role of a slime fighting alongside the rebels against Brain 738 and a spacefaring race of penguins. Become a warrior, archer, or mage and play through your own story to a unique ending!

apps.name: Solis Chronicles
apps.short_description: Fleeing a future that executes the obsolete, Dr. Solis Renforge crash-lands among the dinosaurs, 65 million years in the past. Build a life with a prehistoric tribe, contain the corruption you unleashed, and face a people who fear what your technology makes of them. A sci-fi isekai visual novel.

apps.name: Soliton Burst
apps.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

apps.name: Sort The Dumplings
apps.short_description: Sort a mountain of adorable dumplings into their proper homes in a chaotic, satisfying sorting game. Discover 190 unique dumplings across 19 themed collections, complete shelves, unlock changing environments, and chase faster times across multiple game modes.

apps.name: Spearhead 2
apps.short_description: Spearhead 2 is a tank simulator that puts you in command of an M1A2 Abrams Main Battle Tank in tactical combat. Lead your team through intense missions, strategize effectively, and dominate the battlefield in this immersive mix of action and simulation gameplay.

apps.name: Spinny-Roly 64
apps.short_description: An old-school gem collection game about a roly-poly who likes to bounce around.

apps.name: SPLIT-S
apps.short_description: A flight-combat roguelite inside a strange old computer. Choose your route through a hostile network, raid its defenses, and bring your earnings home. Master three flight modes in one run, then buy hardware upgrades through underground bulletin boards.

apps.name: SporeBloom
apps.short_description: A fungi-fueled 'battle of nutrition!' Turn-based strategy inspired by mycelium networks and territory control. Produce fantastical mushrooms and expand to outgrow your rivals. Develop peacefully or parasitize your friends in multiplayer and solo play - may the fittest fungi survive!

apps.name: Squad Arcade
apps.short_description:
Squad Arcade is a roguelike deckbuilder inside an 80s comic book. Build a squad of five cards, create combos, position them for autobattles. Every run opens new pages, rewards, and strategies.

Every run challenges you to build powerful decks, form unique squads, and master unpredictable challenges.

apps.name: Stackonauts
apps.short_description: The Stackonauts need your help. Build the sturdiest tower you can and get them to the safety of your transport ship. Time, unforgiving physics and your rivals' cannons stand against you across several modes for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Stampholder Value
apps.short_description: Your coworkers favorite deck builder. Weaponize rubber stamps against relentless waves of paperwork. Chain wild stamp combos, collect desk ornaments, and shred through paper enemies in challenging re-playable runs.

apps.name: Standard Procedures
apps.short_description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

apps.name: Stay a Little
apps.short_description: A romance and relationship game set in London. Choose what to say, find work and spend time with people you want to know better. Flirt or take a side, then see how earlier choices change your next conversation.

apps.name: Steal Banana
apps.short_description: Grow your banana empire in a multiplayer farming simulator where nothing is safe. Plant rare trees and collect your bananas, then visit other players farms to steal their crops and take their best trees

apps.name: STEEL LINE
apps.short_description: Descend into a randomly generated rogue-like FPS where no two runs are the same. Explore the anomalous STEEL LINE, stacking powerful items and weapons to create wild synergies. Use highly reactive environments to your advantage and brutally destroy the horrors that await below.

apps.name: StoneWardens
apps.short_description: A goofy roguelike deckbuilder where your runestones are the ammo. Load them, throw them, build a wall out of them, and lead your heroes through four acts of monsters that beatbox, stink and curse. Not your classic deckbuilder - that one (has) rocks !

apps.name: SudoPop
apps.short_description: Sudoku meets idle game. Solve candy-colored boards by hand, hire nine number buddies to solve with you, and watch them build boards out of boards until millions of Sudokus pop every second.

apps.name: Sumo Dynasty
apps.short_description: Run a sumo stable as its oyakata. Raise young men from amateur sumo to the top of the banzuke, survive the Yokozuna Council, buy elder names and build a dynasty, in the most in-depth sumo management game ever made. In English and full Japanese.

apps.name: Sunrise Isles
apps.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

apps.name: Survival Fund Manager
apps.short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

apps.name: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS
apps.short_description: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS is a 2.5D puzzle shooter where you must terminate all hostiles and rescue any hostages. Death is not the end; your previous attempts will replay alongside your current attempt. Choose between 12 unique drones to assemble your swarm and execute the perfect mission.

apps.name: Taj Mod
apps.short_description: Taj Mod is a fan-made reimagining of the SCP: Secret Laboratory 'Megapatch 1' experience. Set in an alternate reality, that blends nostalgia with fresh gameplay and features.

apps.name: Tamzin Twins
apps.short_description: An epic action RPG with couch co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will throw swords, cast spells, vanquish armies and become heroes.

apps.name: Tarpit
apps.short_description: Tarpit is a psychological indie horror game where you have to make TAR to rescue your friend from danger. Beware of the forces in your surroundings. The forces definitely see you... but do you see them?

apps.name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
apps.short_description:
TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads.
Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

apps.name: Tear of Stars
apps.short_description: Control two heroes as one in this atmospheric 2D Metroidvania. Explore two ruined kingdoms, from crystalline ruins to clockwork towers. Seamlessly swap between Asir’s elemental swordplay and Layla’s tactical wire-bow to solve cooperative puzzles and seek the truth behind the Darian legacy.

apps.name: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
apps.short_description: A narrative rhythm game set in 1920. Experience the war against Soviet Russia from a unique perspective. Become a telegraphist and tap out life-or-death messages in Morse code.

apps.name: Thalyn
apps.short_description: Build a cosy world. Then step inside. Create cottages, gardens and places to stay, from above or in first person. Shape the atmosphere with simple choices, text or voice, wander through your creation, and export it as glTF to keep and share. No coding or 3D modelling needed.

apps.name: The Adventures of Portos
apps.short_description: "A 2D Platform hide and seek adventure"

apps.name: The Backrooms Deluxe
apps.short_description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels.

apps.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings
apps.short_description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

apps.name: The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind
apps.short_description: After foreseeing your own death, an unknown colour grants you ten more days to live and the power of Mind-Intrusion. Investigate mysteries and intrude into the minds of locals. When the ten days are up, will you hold on to your sanity and humanity, or become a living mutation?

apps.name: The Darker Night: Regent City
apps.short_description: You are the Regent of the night. You command vampires from your throne and mortals from the shadows. Keep your people fed and hidden from the light. Run night operations, spread your dominion over the city, and decide the fate of humans and vampires alike.

apps.name: The Electorate
apps.short_description: Campaign to victory in the ultimate election simulator, The Electorate. Rally voters, dominate the airwaves, attack rivals, and fight for glory and power across every county in the United States.

apps.name: The Eviscerator
apps.short_description: Step back into the tension and nostalgia of the XBLIG era! Rebuilt and reimagined for PC, this indie horror classic brings back the heart-pounding survival experience that kept players on the edge of their seats.

apps.name: The Friendly Monster
apps.short_description: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

apps.name: The Games You Make
apps.short_description: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

apps.name: The Haunted Archives
apps.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror, set in the 2000s. Break into abandoned places with one camera and limited tape. Dangerous footage earns more views, but recording something can make it react. Film it, survive it, get out. There are ALWAYS secrets to be found.

apps.name: The Hero's Legacy
apps.short_description: A hardcore co-op action RPG in pixel art: play solo, online, on LAN or in 4-player split-screen couch co-op. Dodge bullet-hell bosses, hunt loot and 6-link gear, and build your hero on a huge passive tree. Permadeath: every hero has one life, but your family keeps its Legacy.

apps.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
apps.short_description: The Light in the Darkness: Director’s Cut is a free narrative game following a Polish-Jewish family living in Nazi-occupied France.

apps.name: The Obsidian Sun
apps.short_description: The Obsidian Sun is a 2D action RPG inspired by Aztec/Mexica and Maya cultures. Help a struggling town, master combat and gathering skills, uncover hidden oaths, and defeat corrupted guardians beneath a shattered sun.

apps.name: The Omega Strain
apps.short_description: Pilot your ship through fully explorable polygon worlds, battle colossal alien war machines, and save humanity from The Omega Strain. Featuring endless Simulation Mode and powered by RetroMesh — a custom engine built to push retro 3D beyond the limits of the 1990s.

apps.name: The Orphaned House
apps.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

apps.name: The Symbiant II
apps.short_description: The Symbiant II is a BL-Yaoi-Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

apps.name: The Talos Principle 3
apps.short_description: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

apps.name: The Third Seal
apps.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

apps.name: The Timekeeper
apps.short_description: A third-person puzzle platformer set in a beautiful, engaging world. Players will learn how to carry and shift colors to solve puzzles.

apps.name: The Voss Clinic
apps.short_description: A psychiatric hospital. 1986. The staff are dead. The doors are open. You have no memory of how you got here or why your name is on a patient file. No monsters. No combat. Only the silence of empty corridors, and the slow realization of what was done to you.

apps.name: THE WRONG WAY
apps.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

apps.name: Tidy Bakery
apps.short_description:
Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰

Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

apps.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup
apps.short_description: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.

apps.name: Tie Down
apps.short_description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

apps.name: Tile Former
apps.short_description: Tile Former is a 1-bit puzzle game where the color palette dictates the mechanics. You need to transform the world in various ways and use the palettes at your disposal to solve the puzzles.

apps.name: Timepaths
apps.short_description: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode and infinite levels.

apps.name: Tiny Kopitiam
apps.short_description: Tiny Kopitiam is a cozy management sim inspired by Southeast Asian coffee shops. Build your dream shop, hire staffs, then jump inside as the boss. Sit back, relax and watch your dream kopitiam come alive.

apps.name: Total Neuroscience
apps.short_description: A complete neuroscience study app with two bonus games. Drill every topic from the membrane to the clinic — then run a neuron as a factory, where the same cell biology keeps the line moving.

apps.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
apps.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

apps.name: Touchline Capital
apps.short_description: Touchline Capital is an emergent football business simulation where you run an agency rather than a club. Scout and sign players, assign agents, arrange moves, build commercial value, invest in projects, and expand into new markets around the world.

apps.name: Train of Thought
apps.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

apps.name: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
apps.short_description:
In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it.
Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: 
find out how this story truly ended.

apps.name: Trials of Mary
apps.short_description: Survive 4 deadly trials inspired by classic horror. As Mary, solve environmental puzzles and outsmart hunters through strategic evasion and self-defense in this cinematic journey.
